title: [3.0 RC1] VersionChecker - logs on the first day that the new RC1 version is expired
symptom: After installing 3.0 RC1, on the same day a notification appears stating that a new version has been available for at least 1 day and that fallback to sensor-supported pump therapy will occur after 7 days, and loop will be disabled after 14 days. Logs show 'Version 3.0-rc1 expired.' and 'Version 3.0-rc1 läuft am 31.01.22 ab'.
cause: The behavior is correct because RC versions expire; the message is confusing because it suggests a newer version exists.
evidence_quote: it looks like this behavior is correct. RC really expires
